# Part V — Testing and troubleshooting

Proving an installation on the bench, reading trouble codes, and finding the cause of a symptom.

- **[43 Bench testing](43-bench-testing.md)** — Before the ECU meets an engine, power it on the bench, feed it a pretend engine from a stimulator, and prove that it syncs, reads its sensors and fires every output in the right place — mistakes found on the bench cost nothing.
- **[44 Diagnostics and trouble codes](44-diagnostics.md)** — Every fault the ECU notices becomes a trouble code with a severity, kept in one table that the studio, a scan tool, the board's LEDs and the protection levels all read — and the code tells you where to look.
- **[45 Troubleshooting guide](45-troubleshooting.md)** — Start from what the engine or the studio is doing wrong, check the likely causes in order, and follow the pointer to the chapter that fixes it.
